reuse_resolution.gap: Existing automatic finder assumes unrestricted switching; supplied port verifier requires bijections. New source admits forward inclusions on arbitrary finite directed control graphs. Absorption itself is classical exact resolvent reuse.

methods.hard_boundary: Six-axis nonsingular integer linear actions only. Radius failure is not global unboundedness. Absorption assumes finite homogeneous row-stochastic mass and does not prove bottom-class geometry. Index weights are observer gauges, not physical entropy, heat, probabilities of actual discarded paths or semantic memory. Exponential moments concern an explicit pathwise majorant; overly large z failure is not actual unboundedness.
